description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the HdmiInput plugin for a media or device control system. It manages HDMI input devices, handles events, provides JSON-RPC methods for controlling HDMI settings, reads EDID and SPD data, and interfaces with hardware and other plugins for HDMI-related functionalities.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: Main class implementing HDMI input device management, JSON-RPC methods, event handling, and hardware communication.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up event subscriptions, and prepares resources.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and de-registers event handlers.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus and registers event handlers for HDMI events.

methods.name: getHDMIInputDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected HDMI input devices.

methods.name: readEDID
methods.description: Reads EDID data for a given port and converts it to base64.

methods.name: writeEDID
methods.description: Placeholder function to write EDID data to a device.

methods.name: getRawHDMISPD
methods.description: Retrieves raw SPD data for a given port and encodes it in base64.

methods.name: getHDMISPD
methods.description: Retrieves SPD data for a given port and formats it.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Configures EDID version for a specific port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves EDID version for a specific port.

methods.name: startHdmiInput
methods.description: Starts HDMI input on a specified port with options.

methods.name: stopHdmiInput
methods.description: Stops HDMI input and restores audio levels.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets display rectangle for video scaling.

methods.name: getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Returns list of supported game features like ALLM.

methods.name: getHdmiGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Retrieves status of a specific HDMI game feature on a port.

methods.name: getHdmiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves HDMI version/compatibility info for a port.

methods.name: reportLatencyInfoToHdmiCecSink
methods.description: Reports latency info to the HDMI CEC sink plugin.
